deleteScreenshot.title: Delete Screenshot?
deleteScreenshot.description: This permanently removes the screenshot and its stored image. This cannot be undone.

mergeJob.title: Merge Previous Interrupted Jobs?
mergeJob.description: This permanently deletes {{count}} interrupted job record(s) and folds their route and stats into this delivered job. This cannot be undone.

ingestToken.title: Ingest Token
ingestToken.description: Point your recording agent at this server and authenticate it with the token below. The raw token is shown only once, right after it is generated.
ingestToken.revealWarning: Copy this token now - you won't be able to see it again.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate Ingest Token?
rotateConfirm.description: Generating a new token immediately invalidates the current one. Any recording agent still using the old token will stop streaming until it is updated.
